hero.subtitle: Community-led coastal revitalization in Manseok-dong
hero.title:
나만 아는 해안
My Secret Coast
hero.description: Hidden behind Incheon's industrial waterfront, two overlooked coastlines are being reintroduced as a living cultural destination: a connected walking route, discovery waypoints, a library-linked reading space, outdoor art and open-air programs, and a digital guide that leads people back to the real shore.

waterfront.title: Waterfront Dock
waterfront.description: The Manseok-Hwasu Waterfront Dock is the top local spot for watching the sunset. It provides a wide, open view of the sky and the West Sea, making it easy to capture great photos. It is a go-to destination for anyone looking for the best sunset views and a peaceful sound of waves.

lookout.title: Sea Lookout
lookout.description: Equipped with shared binoculars, this elevated lookout offers a panoramic view of passing ships, distant islands, and the changing tides.

library.title: Coastal Reading Pavilion
library.description: An open-air pavilion stocked with donated books. Pick one up, sit by the railing, and read while the sea reads itself.

cafe.title: Slow Café
cafe.description: A small phone-free café serving hand-drip coffee, seasonal teas, and locally baked bread. Conversation is welcome; notifications are not.

gallery.title: Rotating Art Gallery
gallery.description: A small exhibition space featuring works from local artists, refreshed every season.

bike.title: Coastal Bike Path
bike.description: A 4 km flat path connecting the dock to the southern lighthouse. Bikes are available for free hourly checkout.

reading.zones_title: One Coast, Many Reasons to Slow Down
reading.zones_subtitle: Each zone gives you a different reason to slow down — but they're all part of the same coast.
reading.zones_intro: The zones work as an identity ring: each one serves a different time of day, a different type of person, and a different emotional need, while sharing one physical route and one digital platform.

morning.title: Morning Circuit
morning.description: A calm route for older locals, early walkers, and anyone who wants the coast before the city speeds up.

reader.title: Sea-View Reading Shelter
reader.description: A reason to stay, not just pass through: borrowed books, shade, sea air, and a slower alternative to the cafe ceiling.

heritage.title: 묘도길 Heritage Stops
heritage.description: Lore stops along the trail trace the memory of Cat Island, once tied to Incheon's croaker fishing trade.

reading.heritage_description: Manseok-Hwasu is an Incheon waterfront with a coastline, a walking trail, and a history most people have never heard. Before reclamation reshaped this stretch of coast, the area was anchored by 묘도 — Cat Island — once the heart of Incheon's croaker fishing trade. The island is gone, but its memory runs through the promenade, the port, and the people who lived here.
